title: A Torsion-Free Group Algebra with Zero Divisors
summary: We disprove Kaplansky's zero-divisor conjecture by constructing a finitely presented torsion-free group G for which $`\mathbb F_2[G]`$ has nonzero zero divisors. The group admits a finite two-dimensional classifying space.
family_title: A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture

review.reason: Constructs a torsion-free group whose F2 group algebra has zero divisors, disproving Kaplansky's conjecture.
